evals.prompt: PR #4 was just merged. Clean up the worktree for fix-review-findings and move me back to main.
evals.expected_output: Determines the current branch, moves the session to the main checkout before running the script, previews with DRY_RUN=yes, verifies the PR is MERGED and the worktree is clean, runs node finish-worktree.js fix-review-findings, reports the main checkout path and that the worktree and branch were removed. Never mentions deleting a remote branch except to say it is not done.

evals.prompt: We're done with the feature-x branch after the merge. Finish the worktree.
evals.expected_output: Captures feature-x as the target, moves the session to the main checkout first, runs a dry run, then runs node finish-worktree.js feature-x. If preflight refuses for a dirty worktree or unmerged PR, reports the reason and leaves the worktree intact.
